name: minecart-rail-loop
comment: WP-2.4b. A 5x5 rail loop (x, z in -2..2) at y = 61 on the stone platform, its corners curves (set_block lets RailLogic shape every rail). The north side has a hump: a stone block at (0, 61, -2) with a rail on it, so (-1, 61, -2) and (1, 61, -2) become slopes (metadata 2 and 3). The west side (-2, 61, -1..1) is three powered rails, powered by a redstone torch at (-3, 61, 0) and along the run (BlockRail.isNeighborRailPowered). A minecart (EntityList constructor, id 0) is spawned on the west slope at rest: it rolls down (EntityMinecart.java:232-246, the 1/128 slope pull and getPos's height term), through the curve, is boosted by 0.06 a tick on the powered rails (:396-401), runs round the loop and over the hump five times, its yaw following the motion and turning round at the reversals (:447-470). No super.onUpdate: ticksExisted stays 0. rng_state and entity_state every tick, block_box of the loop every 50 ticks.
